parameter_conventions.CFA_inference: Optimizer convergence,identified,Heywood uniqueness boundary,latent boundary separate. Fitted means/covariance and discrepancy/indices remain descriptive candidate values. No parameterwise Wald p/CI.

parameter_conventions.saved_model: score_parameters=[p,q,means(p),Lambda row-major(pq),Phi row-major(q²),uniquenesses(p)]. Prefix method0/1when calling cfa_scores.
parameter_conventions.fit_indices: df=p(p+3)/2-k includes means. Independence baseline mean=observedmean,cov=diag(S),df0=p(p-1)/2. Baseline discrepancy within64eps*p is treated as numerical zero. Undefined zero-df or baseline denominators returnnull. AICcnull whenN<=k+1.
parameter_conventions.RMSEA_convention: Uses displayed official equation sqrt(max(chi2-df,0)/(N*df)),without arbitrary upper clipping. Help prose saysbounded0..1while its displayed formula lacks upper clipping;the unbounded formula choice is an explicit implementation interpretation,not a verified installed-JMP behavioral claim. CFI/TLI/NFI are clipped[0,1]as prose specifies;RNI is raw/unbounded.
parameter_conventions.RMSEA_CI: Poisson mixture of central gamma CDFs,built around Poisson mode;normalizes retained weight mass. Max noncentrality1e7,max50000mixture offsets,gamma convergence<=200000iterations,bracket/bisection75steps. CentralCDF<=target gives zero noncentrality boundary;zero modeldf givesnull. Cap/no convergence givesnull interval plus explicit status.
parameter_conventions.RMR_SRMR: Unique lower triangle covariance residuals plus all mean residuals,denominatorp(p+3)/2. SRMR covariance residuals divided bysqrt(Sii*Sjj),mean residuals bysqrt(Sii). No omission of nonzero mean terms.
parameter_conventions.RAM: p<=16;linear-system inverses use elimination with pivot rejection. Static invertibility and discrete dynamic stability distinct. Stability solvesP-BPB^T=I by p^2-dimensional linear system;SPD P=>strictly stable,nonSPD=>not strictly stable,singular/numeric unresolved=>null. This extra algebraic diagnostic is not an SEM identification/causality claim.
parameter_conventions.unsupported: No general SEM fitting,cross-loadings,residual correlations,FIML,multigroup/measurement invariance,robust correction,modification indices,or GUI.

reference_interpretation.JMP_estimation: Official SEM-specific estimation link has suffix -2;it explicitly usesN rather thanN-1andobserved-information SE.
reference_interpretation.RMSEA: The displayed equation gives sqrt(max(chi2-df,0)/(Ndf));help prose also saysbounded0..1. Our deliberate mathematical-formula convention has no arbitrary upper clipping;this interpretation is explicit andnot a verified installed-JMP behavioral claim.
reference_interpretation.RMR_SRMR: Own formula expression includes unique lower-triangle covariance residuals andmean residuals,overp(p+3)/2;official equation images were viewed for reading only andnot copied into artifacts.
reference_interpretation.RAM_stability: Discrete Lyapunov SPD criterion is an additional linear-system diagnostic,distinct from static invertibility;it does not establish SEM validity or causality.

N=300;p=6

S=L@P@L.T+np.diag(theta);S[0,5]+=.06;S[5,0]+=.06

def decode(t):
 l=np.zeros((6,2),dtype=np.result_type(t))
 vals=t[:6].copy();vals[0]=np.exp(vals[0]);vals[3]=np.exp(vals[3])
 l[:3,0]=vals[:3];l[3:,1]=vals[3:];u=np.exp(t[6:12]);rho=np.tanh(t[12])
 phi=np.array([[1,rho],[rho,1]])
 return l,phi,u
def fun(t):
 l,phi,u=decode(t);C=l@phi@l.T+np.diag(u)
 return .5*N*(np.log(np.linalg.det(C))-np.linalg.slogdet(S)[1]+np.trace(np.linalg.solve(C,S))-6)
def gradient(t):
 return np.array([np.imag(fun(np.asarray(t,dtype=complex)+1e-20j*np.eye(len(t))[i]))/1e-20 for i in range(len(t))])
def hessian(t):
 def calc(h):
  return np.column_stack([(gradient(t+np.eye(len(t))[i]*h)-gradient(t-np.eye(len(t))[i]*h))/(2*h) for i in range(len(t))])
 H=(4*calc(5e-5)-calc(1e-4))/3;return (H+H.T)/2
start=np.r_[np.log(.8),.8,.8,np.log(.8),.8,.8,np.log(np.ones(6)*.4),np.arctanh(.2)]
fit=optimize.minimize(fun,start,jac=gradient,method='BFGS',options={'gtol':1e-9,'maxiter':1000})

J=np.column_stack([np.imag(physical(t.astype(complex)+1e-20j*np.eye(13)[i]))/1e-20 for i in range(13)])
pc=J@cov@J.T
df=8;chi=float(2*fun(t));base=N*(np.log(np.diag(S)).sum()-np.linalg.slogdet(S)[1]);df0=15
def ncp_ci(x,df):
 def endpoint(q):
  if stats.chi2.cdf(x,df)<=q:return 0.
  hi=max(x,1)
  while stats.ncx2.cdf(x,df,hi)>q:hi*=2
  return optimize.brentq(lambda a:stats.ncx2.cdf(x,df,a)-q,0,hi,xtol=1e-12)
 return [endpoint(.95),endpoint(.05)]
rmci=np.sqrt(np.array(ncp_ci(chi,df))/(N*df))
F=np.log(np.linalg.det(C))-np.log(np.linalg.det(S))+np.trace(np.linalg.solve(C,S))-p
ll=-N/2*(p*np.log(2*np.pi)+np.log(np.linalg.det(C))+np.trace(np.linalg.solve(C,S)))
srmr=np.sqrt(sum((S[i,j]-C[i,j])**2/(S[i,i]*S[j,j]) for i in range(p) for j in range(i+1))/(p*(p+3)/2))
out=dict(N=N,data=np.c_[S,means].tolist(),loadings=l.tolist(),phi=phi.tolist(),uniquenesses=u.tolist(),standard_errors=np.sqrt(np.diag(pc)).tolist(),covariance=C.tolist(),chi_square=chi,degrees_of_freedom=df,baseline_chi_square=base,CFI=max(0,min(1,1-max(chi-df,0)/max(base-df0,0))),RMSEA=np.sqrt(max(chi-df,0)/(N*df)),RMSEA_CI=rmci.tolist(),SRMR=srmr,log_likelihood=ll,gradient_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(gradient(t))),numpy=np.__version__,scipy=scipy.__version__)
Path('/private/tmp/rusta-ducksmiles-jmp-target/sem-check/fixture.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
